verses.1: A psalm of David. I sing of love and justice; to you, LORD, I sing praise.
verses.2: I follow the way of integrity; when will you come to me? I act with integrity of heart within my royal court.
verses.3: I do not allow into my presence anyone who speaks perversely. Whoever acts shamefully I hate; no such person can be my friend.
verses.4: I shun the devious of heart; the wicked I do not tolerate.
verses.5: Whoever slanders another in secret I reduce to silence. Haughty eyes and arrogant hearts I cannot endure.
verses.6: I look to the faithful of the land; they alone can be my companions. Those who follow the way of integrity, they alone can enter my service.
verses.7: No one who practices deceit can hold a post in my court. No one who speaks falsely can be among my advisors.
verses.8: Each morning I clear the wicked from the land, and rid the LORD'S city of all evildoers.

notes.text: Within my royal court: the king promises to make his own household a model for Israel, banning all officials who abuse their power.
I look to the faithful of the land: the king seeks companions only among those faithful to God.

Each morning: the normal time for the administration of justice (2 Sam 15:2; Jeremiah 21:12) and for the arrival of divine aid (Psalm 59:17; 143:8; Isaiah 33:2). I clear the wicked from the land: the king, as God's servant, is responsible for seeing that divine justice is carried out.
